messages: Grace, the 3 hours a day line hit home. Most founders I talk to who are still doing their own sales end up spending the time on accounts that were never going to buy this quarter anyway, and it's brutal because every hour you spend prospecting is an hour not spent on product, hiring or closing the deals that are already in motion. We've been working on this exact problem with a few other founders at your stage, looking at signals like competitor engagement, hiring, and funding to figure out who is actually in-market. Out of curiosity, how are you deciding who to reach out to today?
